top_reviews.title: Run slightly large for thick socks
top_reviews.variant: Size: 7 Big Kid Color: Blast Pink
top_reviews.body: These are great boots! We live in Seattle where the snow never gets deep, so these are perfect, even though they are short. My 11-year-old daughter is a size 7 kids (which is a size 9 women's!) and the size 7 on these runs slightly large. But we both figured that that's because they're designed for thick socks. She tried them on with regular socks. With thick warm winter socks, they will fit well. That's pretty smart from a design perspective, and we appreciate it. She likes these and so do I. It's hard to find kids-designed winter boots that run into the large sizes. I'm glad we found these!

top_reviews.title: Great little toddler boots
top_reviews.body: These boots are great quality. I had no complaints from my 3 year old, despite them running quite big (we ordered a size 8 which is normally a good fit for him). He was able to run and play in the snow for hours without any moisture and with warm toes. They have a good amount of traction - as evidenced by all the running he was doing - and the lacing/zipper combo made for a snug fit around the ankle (which made up for the boots running big). They seem solid and built to last, especially around the soles. Finally, my son loves the different shades of blue and the camo pattern!
